item.title: Lincoln's Ambient Album turns NYC into “The City that Sleeps”
item.description: Lincoln, Hudson Rouge and musician Anders Rhedin created an ambient album of music designed to lull folks to sleep. In an intriguingly counterintuitive move, it incorporates the sounds of perhaps the most bustling metropolis of them all—New York City. item.title: The Clapping Clock website recognizes appreciation of frontline workers ‘round the world
item.description: (New York, NY) -- It’s 7pm in New York City, 21:00 across Europe and around 5:30pm in suburbs throughout the United States. item.title: Media Post: Lincoln Offers Music-Centric Corsair Campaign
item.description: by Tanya Gazdik Lincoln is launching a campaign for its new 2020 Corsair with the help of a newly discovered folk musician, Cas Haley. When searching for the next face of its Corsair campaign, Lincoln turned to unknown and emerging artists and engaged the public to help make the selection. After a songwriting competition and a trip to the Grammys, Haley emerged as the chosen singer and songwriter. item.title: Hudson Rouge Wins Global Mandate, Crafting a Campaign About Family, Legacy, and the Art of Rum.
item.description: Hudson Rouge has been appointed global creative partner for Brugal, the iconic Dominican rum from the Edrington portfolio. Recent press coverage has underscored the brand’s impressive evolution—from a beloved Dominican family heritage rum into a modern luxury spirits brand with global appeal.
